cli.install_help.install.tone: terse, operator-facing, preserves safety and command distinctions
cli.install_help.install.note: Top-level summary: manage local installation generations for the stable lop runtime, not install a new package.

cli.install_help.prune.tone: terse, operator-facing, preserves safety and command distinctions
cli.install_help.prune.note: prune deletes only generations with nothing running from them. Preserve this safety restriction.

cli.install_help.keep.tone: terse, operator-facing, preserves safety and command distinctions
cli.install_help.keep.note: --keep is a non-negative count of unreferenced generations. Preserve %(default)s verbatim: argparse expands it using the declared default. A live/saved-session generation or the current target is never removed; current is a literal pointer name.

cli.install_help.migrate.tone: terse, operator-facing, preserves safety and command distinctions
cli.install_help.migrate.note: migrate copies this install into the generation layout and repoints the literal current pointer.

cli.install_help.status.tone: terse, operator-facing, preserves safety and command distinctions
cli.install_help.status.note: status describes pointer, generations, and the build a newly launched lop would load; lop is an executable token.
